tagline: Committed to meeting the banking and financial needs of our customers and communities for over 130 years
hero_kpi_rationale: Trustmark's primary revenue stems from its traditional bank where net interest margin is the principal driver of profitability. In 2025, declining funding costs supported solid net interest income growth of 8.8%, reflecting the strength of the traditional banking model.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by loans and investments, less deposit interest costs.
kpis.description: Net interest income increased in 2025, driven by lower deposit interest charges despite lower rates.
kpis.signal: Solid growth supported by declining funding costs.

kpis.name: Noninterest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenues from banking services, wealth management, and mortgage activities.
kpis.description: The significant year-over-year increase is primarily attributable to the absence of the $182.8M loss on asset sale in 2024, combined with growth in mortgage banking and wealth management.
kpis.signal: Major uptick in 2025 due to elimination of 2024 exceptional loss.

kpis.name: Wealth Management Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from wealth management and brokerage services.
kpis.description: Revenue reached a record level in Q4 2025, driven by higher management and brokerage commissions.
kpis.signal: Strong and sustainable growth in a high-margin segment.

kpis.name: Mortgage Banking Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues from mortgage loans and associated services.
kpis.description: The business saw increased production and significant profitability improvement, although specific amounts are not provided in available excerpts.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reached record levels in 2025, driven by revenue growth and lower loan loss provisions.
kpis.signal: Historic record in 2025 despite challenging environment.

kpis.name: Return on Assets
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average assets, measures asset utilization efficiency.
kpis.description: ROA remained elevated in 2025, supported by strong net interest margin and good loan portfolio quality.
kpis.signal: Stability in a pressured banking sector.

kpis.name: Return on Tangible Equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by tangible equity, measures shareholder profitability.
kpis.description: ROTE declined versus 2024 due to increased equity following the FBBI sale.

kpis.name: Provision for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential loan losses.
kpis.description: Provision was negative in Q4 2025 (release of -$550K), indicating positive improvement in credit quality and favorable risk migration.

kpis.name: Dividend Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of earnings distributed to shareholders as dividends.
kpis.description: Payout ratio remained moderate, enabling the company to sustain dividend growth.

kpis.name: Number of Branches
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, Trustmark operated 160 full-service branches and 7 limited-service branches, totaling 167 locations.
